sentences.text: The property of the petitioner was acquired and Exts.P1 to P4 awards were passed by the 2 nd respondent.
The petitioner preferred Exts.P5 to P8 statutory applications for enhancement of compensation under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act.
The limited prayer in this Writ Petition is to give a direction to the 1 st respondent to consider and pass orders on Exts.P5 to P8 within a time frame.

Having heard Smt. Smitha Chathanarambath, the learned counsel for the petitioner and Smt. Vidya Kuriakose, the learned Government Pleader, this Writ Petition is disposed of with a direction to the 1 st respondent to dispose of Exts.P5 to P8, in accordance with law after hearing the petitioner,
within a period of six months from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment, if they have not been already disposed.

Sd/-
